newsitem.title: USA: CVS to tender for senior notes due 2000.
newsitem.headline: CVS to tender for senior notes due 2000.

text.p: CVS Revco DS Inc said Wednesday that it is commencing a tender offer to purchase for cash at a "spread offer price" its outstanding 9-1/8 percent senior notes due 2000 aggregating $140,000,000 in principal amount.

The company said the purchase price for the notes will be calculated as the price that would result from a yield to January 15, 1998, the earliest redemption date for the notes, equal to sum of the yield on the 5-1/4 percent U.S. Treasury Note due to December 31, 1997, plus 10 basis points.
The company said it will pay to each tendering holder accrued and unpaid interest for the notes in the tender offer to but not including the applicable settlement date.
